name: Dread Hero
body:
Prerequisites: 5th-level dread, at least 2 levels in non-dread classes.

Benefit: You gain immersed in fear. At 11th level, you gain twin fear.

If you are an 11th-level or higher dread, you add half your total levels in non-dread classes to your dread level when determining the maximum range of your shadow twin.

At 20th level, you gain an additional terror.
